_metadata.notes: Edit values below and commit to GitHub to update the live dashboard. Do not delete _metadata block. Do not delete keys. Numeric fields must remain numeric (no quotes). 2026-08-13: Amador +209 tons SB 1383 food donations (Debbie B-R email 8/12); Tuolumne Tier 1 upgrade pending Cal Sierra quarterlies.

del_norte.name: Del Norte County
del_norte.landfillDestination: Dry Creek Landfill, White City OR
del_norte.dataSource: RDRS 2024 monthly (Del Norte County Transfer Station)

tuolumne.name: Tuolumne County
tuolumne.landfillDestination: Merced County Highway 59 Landfill (RD11086), 94% of tonnage
tuolumne.dataSource: RDRS 2024 quarterly, Cal Sierra Transfer Station (RD10193); Q1 2024 estimated from Q2-Q4 average; composition split for landfilled portion from CalRecycle 2018 field data (DRRR-2020-1666); Big Oak Flat (Groveland) direct disposal not included in this total
tuolumne.greenWasteNote: Cal Sierra reports zero green material for beneficial reuse under SB 1383 rural exemption; source-separated organics collected but sent to disposal via consolidation waiver
tuolumne.woodWasteCaveat: baseline may over-credit wood carbon storage; pending TC internal data (Debbie Reagan 2026-07-24)

amador.name: Amador County
amador.landfillDestination: Forward Landfill (RD11122) primary since 2024, Kiefer Landfill (RD10436) primary 2020-2023
amador.dataSource: RDRS 2024 monthly (Pine Grove + Ione Transfer Stations) plus 2024 EAR SB 1383 edible food recovery (209 tons via Debbie B-R 2026-08-12); composition split for landfilled portion from CalRecycle 2018 field data (DRRR-2020-1666)
